lines.text: Many learners say: I have many money.
Better: I have a lot of money.
Much! I do not have much money.

data.right: I have a lot of money.

native.tip: money는 셀 수 없어서 many 대신 a lot of! “I have a lot of money”예요.

en.tip: Money cannot be counted. Say “I have a lot of money”.
en.caption: Do you say “I have many money”? 😅 Money is uncountable, so use “a lot of” or “much”, not “many”. “I have a lot of money” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
